messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed ~18% of eu-west-gpu nodes marked NotReady over the last 10m. Kubelet logs show repeated TLS handshake failures to the internal auth proxy and a bunch of missing audit events for node-role actions. 

maria: yikes. any recent firewall or proxy changes?

alex: we rolled a stateful firewall tighten yesterday that dropped ephemeral outbound ports to the proxy cluster. Change was intended to restrict mTLS termination surface.

sre_jun: that rings true. conntrack spikes expected if ephemeral ports are closed mid-stream. Can someone run `ss -tnp | grep <proxy-ip>` on a affected node?

ops-annie: grabbing a node now, running checks.

ops-annie: `ss -tnp | grep 10.4.12.23` shows lots of TIME_WAIT + long SYN_RECV, conntrack table 90% full on that host.

maria: hmm audit sink also shows gaps from 16:02-16:20 UTC. looks like the agent couldn't push to logging endpoint.

security-lead: the firewall rule change was deliberate (tighten outbound ephemeral ports to 1024-65535 -> 49152-65535) to comply with new CSP requirements. We thought internal proxies would be unaffected. We're seeing an interaction we missed with older kubelet clients and the proxy NAT behavior.

kevin: quick mitigation option: open ephemeral range back to 1024-65535 for the proxy SG only while we patch older kubelet versions. That keeps the CSP constraint for everything else.

alex: agree that's lowest-risk. also need to rehydrate missing audit events — any chance they were buffered?

maria: audit agent attempts local buffering for up to 5m; these gaps are >15m so unlikely. We'll need backfill from node-level logs and the proxy ingestion queue if it held messages.

sre_jun: action plan suggestion:
- roll ephemeral exception for proxy SG (short-lived)
- drain + restart a small batch of affected nodes to clear conntrack
- patch kubelet client on nodes < v1.x.y (those are failing mTLS renegotiation)
- run an audit backfill from node logs -> central sink

security-lead: +1 on plan but prefer an emergency canary: open exception in one AZ first and validate no CSP policy violations. If green, expand quickly.

devops-bot: deploy request queued: `infra:allow-ephemeral-proxy-sg-exception` by kevin. ETA approval needed from security-lead.

kevin: I'll trigger the canary now in eu-west-1a.

ops-annie: canary applied to 10 nodes in 1a. nodes started reporting Ready again within ~40s. conntrack dropped, TLS handshakes successful. Audit events resume streaming. :relieved:

maria: good sign. cost note: we saw ~2% of traffic rerouted to us-east fallback while nodes were NotReady — that's going to show up in cross-region egress for the hour. Will post numbers after ingestion.

alex: please capture list of kubelet versions affected and node images — we'll need an automated patch rollout. Also create playbook step to avoid this in future (explicit SG exceptions for internal proxies + canary AZ).

security-lead: creating a short-lived JIRA for the CSP exception approval flow + patch plan. Also we should add an automated test in infra CI that simulates tighter ephemeral port ranges against older kubelet clients.

kevin: filing patch job. planning a staged kubelet upgrade: canary 5 nodes -> roll 20% -> full. Keeping the ephemeral-exception until 90% nodes are upgraded, then we'll tighten again and validate.

maria: audit backfill kicked off (job id: audit-backfill-1748901234). will update when done.

ops-annie: FYI the proxy ingestion queue had ~12k events buffered and we replayed them into the sink. Some duplicates deduped at the sink.

sre_jun: postmortem notes: root cause = stateful firewall ephemeral-range change + legacy kubelet mTLS renegotiation behavior + conntrack saturation. Mitigations: short-lived SG exception, kubelet patch, CI test, canary AZ rollout.

alex: thanks all. next steps assigned: kevin (SG canary + patch job), maria (audit backfill + cost report), security-lead (CSP exception formal signoff + CI test), ops-annie (drain/restart playbook entry). Check in 2h.

security-lead: approved the emergency canary. leaving the exception until patches are 80% rolled.

maria: cost report: cross-region egress ~0.6TB ~ $42 for the hot hour, plus ingestion overhead ~ negligible. Not huge but flagging for billing.

alex: solid. closing the immediate alert. we'll convert this thread into a postmortem doc after the backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
